messages:
maya: Quick update from today's runtime launch window: we promoted prefix-dedup + adaptive-routing (v1) to a 1% canary on prod for 90m. Initial telemetry looks promising. :sparkles:
eren: Replayed 36h of mixed-prod traffic with the combined changes. Net: p50 -9%, p95 -13%, p99 -19%. Unit token cost down ~8.5%. Biggest wins on multi-turn small-prefix flows where we avoid duplicate KV lookups.
devops-bot: Canary artifact: https://internal.redwood/bench/2790012345. Summary metrics:
```
- baseline p50 27ms -> canary p50 24.6ms
- baseline p95 135ms -> canary p95 117.5ms
- baseline p99 410ms -> canary p99 333ms
- cost/1k tokens: $0.076 -> $0.069
- 5xx rate: 0.08% -> 0.085% (within noise)
```
carol: Nice. What's the adaptive-routing policy? Did we route by seq-length, inferred latency, or model-cost?
maya: Policy is hybrid: prefer low-cost cached-path if prefix-dedup hit; otherwise route by estimated tail-latency (hot shards -> local kernel). Simple config snippet below:
```
routing:
  prefer_cache_on_hit: true
  seq_thresholds:
    short: 0-48
    mid: 49-256
  fallback: route_to_stable_if_mem_growth
```
zack: Observed a 7% uplift in prefix cache hit-rate after we tuned TTLs and dedup key normalization. That plus routing reduced coalescer fragmentation by ~10%.
eren: We also added a conservative safety fallback: any route seeing p99 > baseline_p99 * 1.12 for two eval windows gets pinned to the stable kernel and emits an alert. Canary config attached to the artifact.
maya: Rollback triggers for the canary are: p99_rel_increase_pct > 12 OR error_rate_abs_increase > 0.5% OR sustained gpu_mem_growth_mb > 45 OR coalescer_queue_tail_ms > 60.
carol: Product wants one sentence for the weekly: can you make it customer-friendly? Avoid internal terms.
maya: Draft for product: "Runtime optimizations reduced median response time by ~9% and p99 by ~19% for common multi-turn chat, with an estimated token cost reduction of ~8.5%."
zack: I'll add sequence-length heatmaps and a small doc on the dedup rules to the canary artifact. Also added a note about normalization edge-cases that caused a tiny uptick in false misses during the replay (we tuned that).
devops-bot: Monitoring hooks bound to runtime.cache.prefix.*, runtime.routing.decision, and gpu.memory.delta. PagerDuty escalation enabled for 90m.
eren: If stable in 90m we ramp to 25% for 2h then full. Thanks for the quick turnaround on this — nice cross-team work. :rocket:
